newsitem.title: LATVIA: BALTA EYES BOURSE'S OFFICIAL LIST.
newsitem.headline: BALTA EYES BOURSE'S OFFICIAL LIST.

text.p: Balta insurance company, which plans to be listed on the Riga stock exchange by July, said on Monday that it wanted to be placed on the bourse's official list and has set its initial share price at 1.75 lats.
"We definitely are looking at joining the official list and our shareholders have approved the initial price at 1.75 lats," Janis Sprincis, Balta's vice-president, told Reuters in an interview.
"Our estimates show that Balta's share price will reach the level of Unibanka in a year's time," Sprincis said.

Balta, the biggest insurance company in the Baltic states by way of paid statutory capital of three million lats, said its first quarter profit came to 282,341 lats against 423,000 lats in after-tax profit for all of 1996.
"We are financially stable and this year look forward to taking half of the vehicle insurance market, estimated at some 10 million lats," Sprincis said.
